#
# This is a Flox environment manifest.
# Visit flox.dev/docs/concepts/manifest/
# or see flox-edit(1), manifest.toml(5) for more information.
#
# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.10.0"

# List packages you wish to install in your environment inside
# the `[install]` section.
[install]
# Python - Python itself is installed on activation via `uv sync`
uv = { pkg-path = "uv", pkg-group = "uv", version = "^0.11.14" }
xmlsec = { pkg-path = "xmlsec", version = "1.3.7" }
freetds = { pkg-path = "freetds" } # For pymssql
# Node
nodejs = { pkg-path = "nodejs_24", pkg-group = "nodejs", version = "24.13.0" } # Same maj.min ver as in Dockerfile; diverges from patch ver
# Set a lower priority on corepack so it takes precedence over nodejs (both bundle pnpm)
# https://flox.dev/docs/man/manifest.toml/#catalog-descriptors
corepack = { pkg-path = "corepack_24", pkg-group = "nodejs", version = "24.13.0", priority = 4 } # Same maj.min as in Dockerfile; diverges from patch ver
brotli = { pkg-path = "brotli", pkg-group = "nodejs" }
zstd = { pkg-path = "zstd", pkg-group = "nodejs" }
openssl = { pkg-path = "openssl", version = "3.4.1", pkg-group = "openssl", outputs = ["bin", "man", "dev", "out"] }
nodemon = { pkg-path = "nodemon" }
# Rust toolchain (based on https://flox.dev/docs/cookbook/languages/rust/)
cargo = { pkg-path = "cargo", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain", version = "1.91.1" }
rustc = { pkg-path = "rustc", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
clippy = { pkg-path = "clippy", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
rustfmt = { pkg-path = "rustfmt", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
rust-lib-src = { pkg-path = "rustPlatform.rustLibSrc", pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
libiconv = { pkg-path = "libiconv", systems = ["aarch64-darwin"], pkg-group = "rust-toolchain" }
rust-analyzer = { pkg-path = "rust-analyzer", pkg-group = "rust-analyzer" } # rust-analyzer should be isolated in its own group, details in cookbook example
lld = { pkg-path = "lld", systems = ["aarch64-darwin"] } # Faster linker for Rust dev builds on macOS
sccache = { pkg-path = "sccache" } # Compilation cache for Rust (also used in CI)
# Go
go = { pkg-path = "go", version = "1.25.5", pkg-group = "go" }
golangci-lint = { pkg-path = "golangci-lint", pkg-group = "go" }
air = { pkg-path = "air" }
# CLI tools
git-lfs = { pkg-path = "git-lfs" }
ripgrep = { pkg-path = "ripgrep" }
mprocs = { pkg-path = "mprocs" }
util-linux = { pkg-path = "util-linux" } # flock
cmake = { pkg-path = "cmake", version = "3.31.5", pkg-group = "cmake" }
sqlx-cli = { pkg-path = "sqlx-cli", version = "0.8.3" } # sqlx
postgresql = { pkg-path = "postgresql_14" } # psql
ffmpeg = { pkg-path = "ffmpeg_5", version = "5.1.4", pkg-group = "ffmpeg" }
protobuf = { pkg-path = "protobuf" } # protoc compiler for gRPC code generation
ninja.pkg-path = "ninja"
emscripten = { pkg-path = "emscripten", pkg-group = "emscripten", version = "4.0.23" }
libpthread-stubs = { pkg-path = "libpthread-stubs", pkg-group = "emscripten" }
watchman = { pkg-path = "watchman" } # Fast file watching for Django/Celery autoreload (uses pywatchman)

# Set environment variables in the `[vars]` section. These variables may not
# reference one another, and are added to the environment without first
# expanding them. They are available for use in the `[profile]` and `[hook]`
# scripts.
[vars]
DEBUG = "1"
POSTHOG_SKIP_MIGRATION_CHECKS = "1"
FLAGS_REDIS_URL = "redis://localhost:6379/1"
# CH client default DB. Matches docker-compose convention — without it,
# Django queries unqualified `events` / `log_entries` etc. resolve against
# the literal `default` DB (where PostHog has no tables) and 500.
CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE = "posthog"
# HMAC secret the agent_stack preview-proxy shares with agent-ingress so
# the JWT minted by Django on every non-live invoke can be verified by
# ingress. Same value on both sides → live JWT round-trip. Dev only.
AGENT_PREVIEW_SECRET = "dev-agent-preview-secret-not-for-prod"
DIRENV_LOG_FORMAT = "" # Disable direnv activation logging (in case direnv is present)
RUST_LOG = "flox=error,flox_rust_sdk=error,flox_watchdog=error" # Suppress Flox logs only (also set in .envrc for early activation)
OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR = "$FLOX_ENV"
OPENSSL_LIB_DIR = "$FLOX_ENV/lib"
DOTENV_FILE = ".env"
OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR = "$FLOX_ENV/include"
LDFLAGS="-L$FLOX_ENV/lib"
CPPFLAGS="-I$FLOX_ENV/include"
RUSTC_WRAPPER = "sccache"
# UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT is set in the [hook]/[profile] scripts, not here: [vars]
# are added without expanding $FLOX_ENV_CACHE, so flox drops it on fresh activation.

# The `hook.on-activate` script is run by the *bash* shell immediately upon
# activating an environment, and will not be invoked if Flox detects that the
# environment has previously been activated. Variables set by the script will
# be inherited by `[profile]` scripts defined below. Note that any stdout
# generated by the script will be redirected to stderr.
[hook]
on-activate = '''
source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/.flox/env/on-activate.sh"
'''

# Scripts defined in the `[profile]` section are *sourced* by *your shell* and
# inherit environment variables set in the `[vars]` section and by `[hook]` scripts.
# The `profile.common` script is sourced by all shells and special care should be
# taken to ensure compatibility with all shells, after which exactly one of
# `profile.{bash,fish,tcsh,zsh}` is sourced by the corresponding shell.
[profile]
bash = '''
  if [ -f "$HOME/.bash_profile" ]; then
    source "$HOME/.bash_profile"
    # ensure even with your shell prefs in place we know this is a Flox.dev env
    export PS1="\033[47m(flox)\033[0m $PS1"
  fi
  unset GOROOT
  export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  # Ensure flox binaries (especially Node.js) take precedence over system binaries
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV/bin:$PATH"
  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if [ ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ]; then
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  elif [ ! -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ] || [ ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]; then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  fi
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate
  # Source hogli bash completions
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/hogli.bash" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/hogli.bash"
  # Load phw worktree helper
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" >/dev/null
  # Route manually-run dependency installs (uv sync, pnpm install, ...) through the dev sandbox on macOS
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims"
'''
zsh = '''
  if [[ -f "$HOME/.zshrc" ]]; then
    source "$HOME/.zshrc"
    # ensure even with your shell prefs in place we know this is a Flox.dev env
    export PS1="%K{white}%F{black}(flox)%k%f $PS1"
  fi
  unset GOROOT
  export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  export GOMODCACHE="$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  # Ensure flox binaries (especially Node.js) take precedence over system binaries
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV/bin:$PATH"
  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if [[ ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate" ]]; then
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  elif [[ ! -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]] || [[ ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ]]; then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  fi
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate
  # Add hogli completions to zsh
  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions/_hogli" ]] && fpath=("$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/completions" $fpath)
  autoload -Uz compinit && compinit -i
  # Load phw worktree helper
  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" ]] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/phw" >/dev/null
  # Route manually-run dependency installs (uv sync, pnpm install, ...) through the dev sandbox on macOS
  [[ -f "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims" ]] && source "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/dev-sandbox-shims"
'''
fish = '''
  set -e GOROOT
  set -gx GOTOOLCHAIN local
  set -gx GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  set -gx GOCACHE "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  set -gx GOMODCACHE "$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  # Ensure flox binaries (especially Node.js) take precedence over system binaries
  fish_add_path -g "$FLOX_ENV/bin"
  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  set -gx UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if not test -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate.fish"
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  else if not test -L "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"; or not test -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  end
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate.fish
'''
tcsh = '''
  unsetenv GOROOT
  setenv GOTOOLCHAIN local
  setenv GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  setenv GOCACHE "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go-build"
  setenv GOMODCACHE "$GOPATH/pkg/mod"
  # Ensure flox binaries (especially Node.js) take precedence over system binaries
  setenv PATH "$FLOX_ENV/bin:$PATH"
  # uv venv path — set here, not in [vars] (which can't expand $FLOX_ENV_CACHE)
  setenv UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  # Recreate venv if it was deleted (on-activate only runs on first activation)
  if ( ! -f "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate.csh" ) then
    uv sync
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  else if ( ! -l "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" || ! -e "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli" ) then
    ln -sf "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/bin/hogli" "$UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/hogli"
  endif
  source $UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/bin/activate.csh
'''

# The `[services]` section of the manifest allows you to define services.
# Services defined here use the packages provided by the `[install]` section
# and any variables you've defined in the `[vars]` section or `hook.on-activate` script.
[services]
# db.command = "postgres -D $FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"

# Additional options can be set in the `[options]` section. Refer to

[options]
systems = ["aarch64-darwin", "aarch64-linux", "x86_64-darwin", "x86_64-linux"]

redis.notes: no [services.*] entry matches kind 'redis' by name or command (see has_service_redis) — nothing to probe. A hook-started process is not a Flox-managed service.

clickhouse.notes: no [services.*] entry matches kind 'clickhouse' by name or command (see has_service_clickhouse) — nothing to probe. A hook-started process is not a Flox-managed service.

[install] pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config" is a native build input (from rust/Dockerfile) with no `outputs` declared — check `flox show pkg-config` for non-default outputs (e.g. `dev` headers) and add `pkg-config.outputs = [...]` if the build needs them

[install] cmake.pkg-path = "cmake" is a native build input (from rust/Dockerfile) with no `outputs` declared — check `flox show cmake` for non-default outputs (e.g. `dev` headers) and add `cmake.outputs = [...]` if the build needs them

[install] protobuf.pkg-path = "protobuf" is a native build input (from rust/Dockerfile) with no `outputs` declared — check `flox show protobuf` for non-default outputs (e.g. `dev` headers) and add `protobuf.outputs = [...]` if the build needs them

issues: No Flox [services.*] blocks at all — postgres, redis, and clickhouse are all brought up via docker-compose in [hook] on-activate instead of being wired as native [services.postgres]/[services.redis]/[services.clickhouse]; the rubric expects them as Flox service blocks (golden wires pg/redis natively, clickhouse via compose)
Because all datastores route through docker-compose, the environment requires a running Docker daemon even for Postgres/Redis, losing `flox services` management and Docker-free reproducibility
Runtimes are correct and idiomatic: python313 @ python3-3.13.13, nodejs_24 @ 24.13.0, plus uv; found the Python pin in pyproject.toml (no dotfile) correctly
Monorepo handling is strong — resolves primary Python/Node runtimes plus Go/Rust workspaces without getting lost in subpackages
Idiomatic on all other axes: $FLOX_ENV_CACHE for venv/corepack/GOPATH/CARGO caches, per-runtime pkg-groups, corepack pnpm shim, no absolute paths or hallucinated URLs
ClickHouse IS started (via compose db/redis7/clickhouse/kafka/zookeeper) so no missing-clickhouse penalty, but not as a Flox service

runs.manifest:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Flox environment for PostHog — a large Python + Node + Go + Rust monorepo.
## Flox pins the host toolchain and auto-installs the app's own dependencies
## (uv / pnpm) on activate. The datastores (Postgres, Redis, ClickHouse, Kafka,
## Zookeeper, object storage) run in Docker via docker-compose.dev.yml — the
## same stack PostHog's own `bin/start` / `hogli` drive.

[install]
# --- Language runtimes ------------------------------------------------------
# Each pinned runtime lives in its OWN pkg-group so its exact version resolves
# against its own catalog snapshot. A single shared group would have to find one
# snapshot carrying all three pins at once and would silently drop a runtime.
python313.pkg-path = "python313"
python313.version = "python3-3.13.13"   # pyproject requires-python ==3.13.13 · ci-backend setup-python · Dockerfile
python313.pkg-group = "python"

nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"
nodejs.version = "24.13.0"               # .nvmrc v24.13.0 · engines.node >=24 <25 · Dockerfile FROM node:24.13.0
nodejs.pkg-group = "node"

go.pkg-path = "go_1_25"
go.version = "1.25.5"                     # go.mod (livestream, hobby-installer, phrocs) · CI setup-go
go.pkg-group = "go"

# rust/ workspace (capture, feature-flags, property-defs-rs, cymbal, ...).
# Catalog exposes an unversioned toolchain; rust/Dockerfile pins 1.91 but Rust
# is forward-compatible, so the current catalog toolchain builds the workspace.
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.pkg-group = "rust"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.pkg-group = "rust"

# --- Python package manager -------------------------------------------------
uv.pkg-path = "uv"                        # uv.lock · [tool.uv] workspace

# --- Build toolchain (Rust workspace + Python native extensions) ------------
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"                      # rust/Dockerfile build-essential · cc linker for -sys crates
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"        # rust/Dockerfile · openssl-sys / xmlsec discovery
cmake.pkg-path = "cmake"                  # rust/Dockerfile · aws-lc-sys / rocksdb builds
protobuf.pkg-path = "protobuf"            # rust/Dockerfile protobuf-compiler · prost-build / tonic-build (protoc)
openssl.pkg-path = "openssl"              # rust openssl-sys · cryptography / xmlsec
openssl.outputs = ["out", "dev"]          # native builds link libssl + need headers

# --- Python native library inputs (xmlsec / lxml / pillow source builds) ----
libxml2.pkg-path = "libxml2"              # lxml, xmlsec
libxslt.pkg-path = "libxslt"              # lxml, xmlsec
zlib.pkg-path = "zlib"                    # pillow
libjpeg.pkg-path = "libjpeg"              # pillow

# --- Service orchestration --------------------------------------------------
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"  # brings up the datastore stack

[vars]
# Keep the compose namespace consistent with .envrc (literal string, safe).
COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME = "posthog"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Datastores (Postgres, Redis, ClickHouse, Kafka, Zookeeper, object storage) ---
  # PostHog runs these in Docker. Bring the core datastores up now when Docker
  # is available; `bin/start` / `hogli` manage the full app + service stack.
  if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export COMPOSE_FILE="$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/docker-compose.dev.yml"
    docker-compose up -d db redis7 clickhouse kafka zookeeper objectstorage 2>&1 | tail -5 >&2 || true
  else
    echo "i  Docker not running — start Docker Desktop / OrbStack, then run 'bin/start'." >&2
  fi

  # --- Python (uv sync into a cache venv, shared with the interactive shell) ---
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  uv sync >&2

  # --- Node (pnpm pinned via packageManager, provisioned with corepack) ------
  # The repo pins pnpm@10.29.3 (packageManager). corepack (ships with nodejs)
  # installs that exact version into a writable cache dir — the Nix node prefix
  # is a read-only store path.
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ] && [ pnpm-lock.yaml -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >&2
  fi

  # --- Go (keep module/build cache out of the repo tree) ---------------------
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/cache"
  export GOMODCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/pkg/mod"
  mkdir -p "$GOPATH" "$GOCACHE" "$GOMODCACHE"

  # --- Rust (keep cargo home + build target out of the repo tree) ------------
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  mkdir -p "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
'''

[profile]
common = '''
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/target"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$GOPATH/bin:$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
'''
bash = '''
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
'''
zsh = '''
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
'''
fish = '''
  test -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate.fish"; and source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate.fish"
'''

[options]
# x86_64-darwin (Intel Mac) is dropped: cargo, rustc, uv, openssl, protobuf,
# libjpeg and docker-compose have no current x86_64-darwin build in the catalog.
systems = ["aarch64-darwin", "aarch64-linux", "x86_64-linux"]

  fi

go_1_25.pkg-path = "go_1_25"                # livestream/go.mod + CI setup-go (go 1.25.5)
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"                    # rust/ + funnel-udf Cargo workspaces
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"

# --- Package managers ---
uv.pkg-path = "uv"                          # uv.lock (uv workspace)

# --- Native build inputs for the Rust workspace (rust/Dockerfile builder stage +

pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
openssl.pkg-path = "openssl"
openssl.outputs = ["out", "dev"]            # openssl-sys links libssl + needs headers
cmake.pkg-path = "cmake"                    # rdkafka-sys / rocksdb / aws-lc-sys
protobuf.pkg-path = "protobuf"              # prost-build / tonic-build (protoc)

gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"

libxml2.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
libxslt.pkg-path = "libxslt"
libxslt.outputs = ["out", "dev"]

  # --- Node: exact pnpm@10.29.3 via corepack, then the pnpm workspace install ---

  export COMPOSE_FILE="docker-compose.dev.yml"
  if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker-compose up -d db redis7 clickhouse kafka objectstorage 2>&1 | tail -5 >&2 || true
  else
    echo "⚠  Docker not running — start Docker Desktop, then: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d" >&2
  fi
'''

[profile]
bash = '''
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$CARGO_HOME/bin:$GOPATH/bin:$PATH"
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
'''
zsh = '''
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"

  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
'''
fish = '''

  set -x GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  fish_add_path "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" "$CARGO_HOME/bin" "$GOPATH/bin"
  test -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate.fish"; and source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate.fish"
'''

## Flox Environment Manifest -----------------------------------------
##
##   _Everything_ you need to know about the _manifest_ is here:
##
##   https://flox.dev/docs/reference/command-reference/manifest.toml/
##
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flox manifest version managed by Flox CLI
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify — PostHog monorepo (Python + Node + Go + Rust)


## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
# Runtimes pinned to the versions the repo declares. Each language sits in its
# own pkg-group so an exact pin resolves independently — pkg-groups only affect
# catalog resolution; the activated environment merges every group onto one PATH.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
[install]
# Python — pyproject.toml requires-python ==3.13.13 (CI ci-backend.yml: 3.13.13)
python313.pkg-path = "python313"
python313.version = "python3-3.13.13"
python313.pkg-group = "python"

# Node — .nvmrc v24.13.0 / package.json engines.node ">=24 <25"
nodejs_24.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"
nodejs_24.version = "24.13.0"
nodejs_24.pkg-group = "node"

# Go — livestream/go.mod, bin/hobby-installer/go.mod, tools/phrocs/go.mod: go 1.25.5
go_1_25.pkg-path = "go_1_25"
go_1_25.version = "1.25.5"
go_1_25.pkg-group = "go"

# Rust — rust/ workspace (~40 crates); rust/Dockerfile FROM rust:1.91 (catalog
# floor is 1.95, newer & backward-compatible). cargo+rustc share one group/page.
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"
cargo.version = "1.95.0"
cargo.pkg-group = "rust"
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"
rustc.version = "1.95.0"
rustc.pkg-group = "rust"

# Python package manager — uv.lock present (drives uv sync in the hook).
uv.pkg-path = "uv"
uv.version = "0.11.25"
uv.pkg-group = "uv"

# Leaf datastore — docker-compose.base.yml db: postgres:15.12-alpine (served below).
postgresql_15.pkg-path = "postgresql_15"
postgresql_15.version = "15.12"
postgresql_15.pkg-group = "postgres"

# Rust/native build toolchain — rust/Dockerfile installs build-essential, cmake,
# libssl-dev, pkg-config, protobuf-compiler; rust/Cargo.lock has openssl-sys,
# rdkafka-sys, zstd-sys, libsqlite3-sys (they vendor their C deps via cc/cmake).
openssl.pkg-path = "openssl"
openssl.version = "3.6.2"
openssl.outputs = ["out", "dev", "bin"]          # openssl-sys links libs+headers (not default outputs)
openssl.pkg-group = "openssl"
protobuf.pkg-path = "protobuf"
protobuf.version = "34.1"                          # protoc for prost-build (rust/Dockerfile)
protobuf.pkg-group = "protobuf"

# Docker Compose — starts the config-coupled stores (ClickHouse, Kafka, object
# storage) that do NOT reduce to a single catalog package (see [hook] below).
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"
docker-compose.version = "5.3.0"
docker-compose.pkg-group = "compose"

# Unversioned tools/libs — latest builds cover all targeted systems, co-resolve in toplevel.
redis.pkg-path = "redis"                          # catalog is 8.x; wire-compatible with the repo's redis 7.2
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
cmake.pkg-path = "cmake"
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
libxml2.pkg-path = "libxml2"                       # lxml / xmlsec source-build fallback
libxslt.pkg-path = "libxslt"


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
##  Literal strings only. Dynamic/computed values live in [hook].
##  Local dev points the app at the Flox-managed Postgres/Redis (127.0.0.1);
##  .env.example's docker hostnames (db/redis7) are for the containerized web.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
[vars]
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "posthog"
PGPASSWORD = "posthog"
PGDATABASE = "posthog"
DATABASE_URL = "postgres://posthog:posthog@127.0.0.1:5432/posthog"
REDIS_URL = "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"
GOTOOLCHAIN = "local"


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
##  Bash. Bridges Flox (runtimes) to the ecosystem package managers, sets up
##  per-project caches, initialises the Postgres cluster, and brings up the
##  config-coupled stores via docker-compose when Docker is available.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Go / Rust: keep build artifacts and module caches out of the repo tree ---
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export GOCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/cache"
  export GOMODCACHE="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go/pkg/mod"
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/rust-target"
  mkdir -p "$GOPATH" "$GOCACHE" "$GOMODCACHE" "$CARGO_HOME" "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"

  # --- PostgreSQL: initialise the cluster once (served by [services.postgres]) ---
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" --username="$PGUSER" --auth=trust --no-locale --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null || true
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"

  # --- Python: uv-managed venv synced from uv.lock, using the Flox Python 3.13.13 ---
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  export UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-system
  export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never
  if [ -f uv.lock ]; then
    uv sync --quiet >&2 || echo "WARN  uv sync failed — run 'uv sync' once network/deps are available" >&2
  fi

  # --- Node: exact pnpm@10.29.3 via corepack (package.json packageManager pin) ---
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ pnpm-lock.yaml -nt node_modules ]; then
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >&2 || echo "WARN  pnpm install failed — run 'pnpm install' manually" >&2
  fi

  # --- Config-coupled stores (ClickHouse, Kafka, object storage) via docker-compose ---
  # These mount server config / are reached transitively, so they stay with the
  # project's compose orchestration rather than becoming bare Flox services.
  export COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.dev.yml
  if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    docker-compose up -d clickhouse kafka objectstorage 2>&1 | tail -3 >&2
  else
    echo "WARN  Docker not running — ClickHouse/Kafka/object-storage not started." >&2
    echo "      Start Docker, then: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d clickhouse kafka objectstorage" >&2
  fi
'''


## Profile script ----------------------------------------------------
## ... sourced by _your shell_ when you run 'flox activate'.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------
[profile]
bash = '''
  source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" 2>/dev/null || true
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$GOPATH/bin:$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
'''
zsh = '''
  source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" 2>/dev/null || true
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$GOPATH/bin:$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
'''
fish = '''
  test -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate.fish"; and source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate.fish"
  set -x GOPATH "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  set -x CARGO_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  fish_add_path "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" "$GOPATH/bin" "$CARGO_HOME/bin"
'''


## Services ---------------------------------------------------------
##  Leaf datastores the app cannot boot without. dev-only settings noted below.
## ------------------------------------------------------------------
[services.postgres]
# auth=trust is dev-only (no password enforcement) — not safe for shared machines.
command = '''
  exec postgres -D "$PGDATA" -p "$PGPORT" -k /tmp -c listen_addresses="$PGHOST"
'''

[services.redis]
# --save "" / --appendonly no => no persistence; data resets on stop (dev-appropriate).
command = '''
  exec redis-server --port "$REDIS_PORT" --dir "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis" --save "" --appendonly no
'''


## Other Environment Options -----------------------------------------
[options]
# Targets the three systems the pinned runtimes build for. x86_64-darwin
# (Intel Mac) is omitted: nixpkgs no longer ships x86_64-darwin builds for the
# current node/python/uv releases this repo tracks. Add it back if you must
# support Intel Macs and are willing to hold those runtimes back a release.
systems = [
  "aarch64-darwin",
  "aarch64-linux",
  "x86_64-linux",
]

gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"                      # build-essential (rust/Dockerfile, llm-gateway)

  fi

  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"
  export GOPATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/go"
  export CARGO_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/cargo"
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$GOPATH/bin:$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
'''
zsh = '''
  [ -f "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate" ] && source "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv/bin/activate"

python313.pkg-path = "python313"
python313.version = "python3-3.13.13"    # pyproject requires-python == 3.13.13 (exact)

nodejs_24.version = "24.13.0"             # .nvmrc / engines.node ">=24 <25"
nodejs_24.pkg-group = "node"
go_1_25.pkg-path = "go_1_25"              # CI setup-go 1.25.5 / Dockerfiles golang:1.25.5
cargo.pkg-path = "cargo"                  # rust/ Cargo workspace (rust/Dockerfile rust:1.91)
rustc.pkg-path = "rustc"

# --- Ecosystem package managers / tooling ---
uv.pkg-path = "uv"                        # uv.lock -> uv sync
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"  # brings up docker-compose.dev.yml services

# --- Native build libraries (Rust *-sys crates + Python C extensions) ---
pkg-config.pkg-path = "pkg-config"
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"                      # build-essential (rust/Dockerfile, llm-gateway)
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
cmake.pkg-path = "cmake"                  # rust/Dockerfile apt install cmake
protobuf.pkg-path = "protobuf"            # rust/Dockerfile protobuf-compiler (protoc)
openssl.pkg-path = "openssl"              # openssl-sys / xmlsec / cryptography
openssl.outputs = ["out", "dev"]          # libssl.so (out) + headers/.pc (dev) — neither default
libxml2.pkg-path = "libxml2"              # lxml / xmlsec
libxml2.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
libxslt.pkg-path = "libxslt"              # lxml / xmlsec
libxslt.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
libjpeg.pkg-path = "libjpeg"              # Pillow
libjpeg.outputs = ["out", "dev"]
zlib.pkg-path = "zlib"                    # Pillow
zlib.outputs = ["out", "dev"]

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  # --- Python: uv + uv.lock (venv kept in cache, never in the repo tree) ---
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv"
  export UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-system   # use Flox's pinned Python 3.13.13
  if command -v uv >/dev/null; then
    uv sync --frozen 2>&1 | tail -5 >&2 \
      || echo "⚠  uv sync failed — run 'uv sync' manually" >&2
  fi

  # --- Node: pnpm pinned to 10.29.3 via corepack (packageManager field) ---
  export COREPACK_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/corepack"
  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin"
  corepack enable --install-directory "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin" pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  export PATH="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/node-bin:$PATH"
  if
